guitar.modelsText: Les Paul-style (Ray Toro) / Squier Telecaster (Frank Iero)
guitar.notes: Frank Iero is well documented playing Squier/Fender Telecasters with custom finishes; Ray Toro favored Les Paul-style guitars.

tone.target: bright punk-pop crunch with chorus lift
tone.profile: bright punk-pop crunch with chorus lift
tone.summary: A bright, punchy signal chain using a light overdrive and Chorus to achieve the required punk-pop crunch, modeled after classic Marshall tones.
corrections: lean more punk-pop than emo metal

rig.name: My Chemical Romance - Helena - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and unwanted noise from the guitar signal.
Provide the necessary light overdrive and crunch for palm-muted punk chords.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used as a general low-gain boost to simulate classic Marshall tube breakup, fitting the 'light overdrive' requirement.

alternatives.reason: Similar function but might be slightly warmer.

blocks.purpose: Wah is explicitly avoided by the musical verdict.
Used as a subtle saturation layer to enhance the crunch without sounding like heavy distortion.
blocks.gap: While Green OD handles most of the grit, adding a minimal DST setting helps maintain the 'crunch' character required for punk-pop.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the classic Marshall/Marshall-style amp tone, providing bright upper mids and punchy punk rock power.

alternatives.reason: A good alternative if the UK 45 is too aggressive.

blocks.purpose: Provide the classic Marshall-style cabinet sound (4x12) to complement the UK 45 amp model.
Add the required 'big open chorus power chords' lift and width without sounding overly wet.
blocks.gap: The Chorus is used specifically for its thickening effect on power chords, fulfilling a key requirement. It must be kept subtle to avoid excessive modulation.

alternatives.reason: Too aggressive and unsuitable for the required punk-pop sound.

blocks.purpose: Provide a subtle sense of space and lift for the chorus chords without creating a 'heavy delay wash'.
blocks.gap: Using a minimal setting on the MOD module (acting as a very short, clean echo/reverb tail) to add dimension.

blocks.purpose: Add the required 'short room' ambience and depth to the overall tone.

alternatives.reason: Room reverb is generally better suited for punk/pop rock ambiance.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism and overall punch by swapping the default IR for a more genre-appropriate, bright 4x12.

proposals.reason: Enhance the bright, punchy punk-pop character and upper mids.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased clarity and definition in the high end.
